scope: Deeper consumer testing, web form and field editing corrections, media list feedback and stalled playback recovery.

topics.title: Hands-free web field editing
details: Dictation inserts at the spoken caret rather than always appending. Voice selection, replacement and scratch operate on staged field text before Save field. Typed caret changes clear outdated voice selections.

topics.title: Guided modern forms
details: Guided forms include labelled contenteditable fields and custom checkbox, radio and option controls. Available fields are rechecked after an answer so newly revealed conditional fields can be prompted. Ambiguous changes stop the guide and request a fresh page read.

topics.title: Field lists and read-only controls
details: Removed the 30-field cap from guided form lists. Disabled and read-only fields are not offered as editable answers. Read-only controls announce their state and reject dictation and destructive editing.

topics.title: List feedback and voice exit
details: Web field and favorite lists announce their boundaries on entry and repeated movement, and Close list returns to the virtual page view. Initial radio and podcast search results now announce the boundary before the result details.

topics.title: Private field masking
details: Password values are masked in selected-label metadata as well as the ordinary value property. A fixture credential regression test checks that the value is absent from the snapshot and spoken responses.

topics.title: Stalled audio recovery
details: Starting or resuming audio has a 12-second deadline. Failed starts clear the player state; a stalled stream returns control with an error instead of waiting indefinitely.

topics.title: Consumer testing and remaining limits
details: Added long and mixed keyboard/voice workflows for documents, notes, drafts, help, tutorials, sleep and resume, radio presets, podcast subscriptions and finite menus. Real browser fixtures cover large forms, conditional fields, custom controls, cross-site history, field selection and cursor consistency.

Windows checks run the new browser tasks in Firefox, Chrome, Edge and Brave and exercise audio decoding and transport. A separate read-only audit attempts real public websites, search engines, radio catalogs, podcast feeds and streams; website verification, network errors and inaccessible content are recorded separately from navigation failures.

Synthesized SAPI and eSpeak US/UK utterances are passed through Vosk and, when installed, Parakeet. Matching recognized commands are dispatched through isolated application fixtures. Recognition errors are reported separately; this is not a microphone or background-noise accuracy test.

Password and file-upload entry still require private keyboard or manual input. CAPTCHA and website verification may need help. No test establishes recognition accuracy with a particular microphone or verifies personal authenticated accounts.
